headline: Crypto Firms Move to Freeze Stolen Binance Assets as Experts Debate Recovery
summary: Tether, Circle, and other crypto entities moved within hours to freeze billions in stolen crypto following a Binance hack, while legal experts question whether smaller victims will receive similar protection.
why: Rapid interventions by stablecoin issuers highlight centralized control mechanisms within cryptocurrency networks during major security breaches.

impacts.name: Tether
impacts.why: Active freezing of tokens demonstrates emergency intervention capabilities by stablecoin issuers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: High-profile security breaches and subsequent token freezes on major crypto platforms impact investor confidence and liquidity flows across digital assets.
